title: 第十四章 韩晖
content_zh:
贾珩将心头那一点被「渠道剥削」的不爽压下，点了点头，拱手道：「还要多谢刘老先生体谅。」
「好说，好说。」刘通放下手中毛笔，笑道：「购稿文契业已写好，贾公子看看，可还有哪里不妥，需要商议丶改动之处？」
说着，将书就的文契和及一盒红泥递了过去。
贾珩仔细审视了下，二百四十回书目，一回二两，三月交齐……点了点头，道：「老先生行文缜密，立契公道，并无不妥。」
说着，提起笔洗上搁置的毛笔，在两张文契上分别题了名，捺了指印。
见贾珩签契，刘通手捻颌下胡须，脸上也现出一抹笑意，道：「贾公子，按着行中约稿之规矩，原本先付前十五回的定金，但贾公子出身人品，老朽自是信的过，这是五十两定金，贾公子收好。」
说着，取出一张摺叠整齐的五十两票面的银票，解释道：「这是四通钱庄的银票，见票即兑。」
所谓定金，这方世界也有着「定金罚则」，若翰墨斋违约，则定金不予返还，若贾珩违约，则双倍返还定金。
贾珩收好银票，拱手道：「老先生放心，某在月底会将前十五回目交稿。」
契约商定下来，贾珩心头也是松了一口气。
二百四十两，对他同样是一笔巨款。
这可以类比前世，这笔款子在二三十万人民币，可以提辆差一点儿的车了。
而三国演义一旦
比如西游记？
《西游记》在前世，出版成书于万历年间，陈汉自嘉靖朝明亡后定鼎神京，哪里有隆庆丶万历？
「四大名着，水浒此世已有，红楼梦……嗯，这个就不能写，西游记抄完，就改抄金庸的射鵰三部曲……」贾珩思忖着。
想要走科举入仕之路，就不能大张旗鼓的行商贾之事。
但不行商贾，就没有银钱，不说日常嚼用糜费，就说将来，哪怕是养军，钱粮又从何处来？
「其实，或许可以寻一些……白手套？」
贾珩目光闪了闪，觉得或许可以让蔡婶，收购一家书坊，然后再养一些生计艰难的文人，充当写手……

甚至其他生意也不是不能做。
「此事还需从长计议。」贾珩在心底压下此事，抬头向刘通开口告辞。
刘通道：「那老朽送送贾公子。」
说着，随着贾珩一同下了二楼。
贾珩下了翰墨斋二楼，来到柜前，从夥计手中接过购得的时文汇编札集，冲翰墨斋的刘通，拱手一礼，说道：「刘老先生留步。」
「贾公子慢走。」刘通笑着冲贾珩点了点头，一直目送其出了翰墨斋大门，方手捻颌下胡须，拿着书稿，转身来到柜台之后，仍是爱不释手，眯眼观赏。
「不意贾家还有这等风流人物。」刘通越看越是满意。
却说贾珩出了翰墨斋，正要向家走去，忽地，就听到一声清朗的呼唤。
「贾兄，请了。」
贾珩定住身形，抬眸看去，只见是一个青衫直裰，手拿摺扇的青年，正微笑地看着自己，那青年头戴士子方巾，面容儒雅，让人如沐春风，一旁还有一个青年，身形魁梧一些，浓眉下，目光炯炯，打量着贾珩。
「这位兄台，贾某有礼了。」贾珩也是拱手回礼道。
然后，二人通了名姓丶表字。
青衫直裰的青年名唤韩晖，字子升；另一位名唤于缜，表字文度，二人都在国子监读书。
韩晖笑道：「贾兄方才一首临江仙，澹泊旷远，豪迈慷慨，实在让小可大开眼界。」
于缜笑道：「气象雄浑，隐有一代大家之风，只是词中旷达丶萧索之意，倒似有另有苦衷，可字儿，藏锋金戈锐利，让人不敢逼视。」
一句话，词的心态如看破世情，宦海沉浮的夕阳馀晖，但字儿却偏偏如初升之阳，其道大光。
贾珩笑了笑，说道：「前些时日，夜读三国史，难免生出昨日金戈铁马，今夕白云苍狗之叹，遂在词中显露一二。」
这也是一种合理合情的解释。
人的情绪本就随时随事而变，比如许多文人都曾做过咏史怀古诗，也未必都经过什麽世态炎凉的世情，更多是一种见他人丶见天地的感慨。
甚至李白也曾以女子视角写闺怨诗，难道李太白还是妇人不成？

于缜面露恍然，朗声笑道：「怪不得，慷慨悲壮又不乏昂扬之势。」
韩晖笑道：「贾兄，时至正午，不若借一不说话，在下听说楼中新开了一家名为玲珑阁的酒楼，不若我们边喝酒边谈。」
韩晖不愧是善于交游，待人接物，于润物无声中就透着一股舒服。
贾珩沉吟了下，笑道：「既是韩兄相邀，那就恭敬不如从命。」
他也有意和读书人结交，既然决定走科举之路，此类的交游就不可缺少。
几人说着，就向着玲珑阁而去。
这是一座高有五层的酒楼，装饰精美，从门前停靠的马车来看，无不非富即贵。
韩晖一边前面引路，一边笑着介绍道，「这家酒楼是月初开的，听说里面的厨子是宫里出来的御厨，做的狮子头也是一绝。」
贾珩随着韩晖向上行去，来到二楼。
唤过夥计，寻了一个厢房，周方以屏风隔断，内里空间轩敞，几桌明亮，这时，环佩叮当，兰麝之香暗浮，有几个衣裙光鲜，姿色秀丽的女子，奉送茶点，然后徐徐而退。
贾珩沉吟了下，道：「韩兄，初次见面，这如何好让你这般破费？」
他和这韩晖不过初识，此人就这般盛宴款待，其意难明。
这可能多少有些被迫害妄想症。
韩晖笑道：「贾兄客气了，纵然不遇上贾兄，我和文度，也准备来此尝尝鲜，贾兄只管安坐，下次说不得就随便在路边找个面摊，就边吃边谈了。」
于缜也笑道：「韩兄说的不错，我们天天在国子监中吃得也没有滋味，出来就是为着这一顿。」
见二人一唱一和，说的坦诚丶有趣，贾珩就是笑道：「是在下失礼了。」
而后，倒也坦然受之。
韩晖目光闪了闪，暗暗点头，这位宁国公的贾公子，举止有度，不卑不亢，倒不像是个小门小户出来的，暗道，不愧是能写出「古今多少事，尽付笑谈中」这等句子的人物。
有句话，三代养不出贵族，如果出身卑贱，遇着权贵，要麽谄谀卑己，要麽恃才傲物。
韩晖交游广阔，别的本事可能没有，但这察颜观色的本领，已是历练出来了的。

他带这位出身宁国府的落魄子弟有意来此，就是一观其人底色。
不管是从方才颇有丽色的婢女前来，而这位贾兄面不改色，目光清正，再到闻处华楼而坦然自若，就不像是出身寒门的子弟该有的模样。
三人吃着茶，就叙着话。
与之交谈，果见对答如流，见识不凡，韩晖暗暗点头。
话赶话，就提到了科举进学。

content_en:
Jia Heng suppressed the dissatisfaction of being "exploited by channels" in his heart, nodded, cupped his hands and said, "Thank you, Mr. Liu, for your understanding."
"Easy to say, easy to say." Liu Tong put down the brush in his hand and said with a smile: "The contract for purchasing the manuscript has been written. Mr. Jia, take a look. Is there anything wrong that needs to be discussed or changed?"
With that said, he handed over the written document and a box of red mud.
Jia Heng examined it carefully. There were 240 bibliographies, one for two taels, and they were submitted in three months... He nodded and said, "The old gentleman's writing is meticulous and the contract is fair. There is nothing wrong with it."
As he spoke, he picked up the brush resting on the washer, inscribed his name on the two deeds, and made his fingerprints.
Seeing Jia Heng signing the contract, Liu Tong twirled his beard under his chin with his hand, a smile appeared on his face, and said: "Master Jia, according to the rules of the industry, I originally paid the deposit for the first fifteen times, but Mr. Jia's background and character, I can trust it. This is fifty taels of deposit, Mr. Jia, keep it."
As he spoke, he took out a neatly folded fifty-tael banknote and explained, "This is a banknote from Sitong Bank. It can be redeemed on sight."
The so-called deposit, this world also has a "deposit penalty". If Hanmo Zhai defaults, the deposit will not be returned. If Jiaheng defaults, the deposit will be doubled.
Jia Heng collected the banknotes and said, "Don't worry, old man, I will submit the first fifteen chapters at the end of the month."
After the contract was agreed upon, Jia Heng breathed a sigh of relief.
Two hundred and forty taels was also a huge sum of money for him.
This can be compared to the previous life. This amount of money was two to three hundred thousand yuan, which could afford a car of comparable quality.
And once the Romance of the Three Kingdoms
Like Journey to the West?
"Journey to the West" was published in the previous life during the Wanli period. Chen Han established the capital of China after the fall of the Jiajing Dynasty and the Ming Dynasty. Where can there be Longqing and Wanli?
"The four great masterpieces, Water Margin has been published in this world, Dream of Red Mansions...well, I can't write this one. After I finish copying Journey to the West, I will copy Jin Yong's The Condor Trilogy..." Jia Heng thought.
If you want to take the imperial examination and become an official, you can't do business in a big way.
But without merchants, there would be no money. Let’s not talk about the daily waste, let’s talk about the future. Even if it is to raise an army, where will the money and food come from?
"Actually, maybe we can find some... white gloves?"
Jia Heng's eyes flashed, and he thought that maybe Aunt Cai could buy a bookshop, and then support some literati who were struggling to make a living as writers...
Even other businesses are not impossible.
"This matter needs long-term consideration." Jia Heng suppressed the matter in his heart, raised his head and said goodbye to Liu Tong.
Liu Tongtong said: "The old man will send Mr. Jia off."
With that said, he followed Jia Heng down to the second floor.
Jia Heng went down to the second floor of Hanmo Studio and came to the counter. He took the collected collection of contemporary texts from the clerk, bowed his hand to Liu Tong of Hanmo Studio and said, "Mr. Liu, stay here."
"Master Jia, let's go slowly." Liu Tong smiled and nodded to Jia Heng, watching him leave the Hanmo Studio gate. He twirled his beard under his chin with his square hands, took the manuscript, turned around and came to the counter, still couldn't put it down and squinted to watch.
"I didn't expect that the Jia family still has such a romantic figure." Liu Tong became more and more satisfied as he looked at it.
But Jia Heng left Hanmo Studio and was about to walk home when suddenly he heard a clear call.
"Brother Jia, please."
Jia Heng steadied his body and looked up, only to see a young man in a straight green shirt with a folding fan in his hand, looking at him with a smile. The young man was wearing a scholar's square scarf and his face was elegant, making people feel like spring breeze. There was another young man beside him, who was taller and taller, with thick eyebrows and bright eyes, looking at Jia Heng.
"Brother, Jia is so polite." Jia Heng returned the greeting with his hands raised.
Then, the two of them exchanged their first names, surnames, and first names.
The young man in a green shirt was named Han Hui, whose courtesy name was Zisheng; the other was named Yu Zhen, whose courtesy name was Wendu. Both of them were studying in the Imperial College.
Han Hui said with a smile: "Brother Jia just wrote a poem about Linjiang Immortal. He was calm and far away, heroic and generous.The sentiment was really eye-opening for Xiao Ke. "
Yu Zhen smiled and said: "The atmosphere is majestic and has the style of a great generation. However, the words are broad-minded and desolate, which seems to have other reasons. But the words are so sharp that people dare not look at them."
In a word, the mentality of the words is like seeing through the world, the afterglow of the sunset in the ups and downs of officialdom, but the words are like the rising sun, its way is bright.
Jia Heng smiled and said: "A few days ago, when I read the history of the Three Kingdoms at night, I inevitably gave birth to the sigh of yesterday's fighting and iron horses, and tonight's white clouds and gray dogs, so this was revealed in my poems."
This is also a reasonable and reasonable explanation.
People's emotions change at any time and with things. For example, many literati have written poems about history and nostalgia. They may not have experienced the harsh conditions of the world. They are more of a feeling of seeing other people and seeing the world.
Even Li Bai once wrote poems about boudoir from a woman's perspective. Could it be that Li Taibai was still a woman?
Yu Zhen's face showed a sudden realization, and he laughed loudly and said: "No wonder, he is generous and tragic but also high-spirited."
Han Hui smiled and said, "Brother Jia, it's noon, why don't we just take a break and not talk. I heard that a new restaurant called Linglong Pavilion has opened in the building, so why don't we talk over a drink."
Han Hui is indeed good at socializing and dealing with people, and Yu Runwu feels comfortable in his silence.
Jia Heng pondered for a moment and said with a smile: "Since Brother Han invites me, it's better to be respectful than to obey."
He also intended to make friends with scholars. Since he decided to take the imperial examination, such friendships were indispensable.
As they spoke, they headed towards Linglong Pavilion.
This is a five-story restaurant with exquisite decoration. Judging from the carriage parked in front of the door, it is nothing but wealth and wealth.
Han Hui led the way and introduced with a smile, "This restaurant opened at the beginning of the month. I heard that the chef inside is an imperial chef from the palace, and the lion's head he makes is excellent."
Jia Heng followed Han Hui up to the second floor.
I called the waiter and found a side room, which was partitioned off by a screen. The space inside was spacious and bright with several tables. At this time, the rings jingled and the fragrance of orchid and musk floated. There were several beautiful women in bright dresses, offering refreshments, and then slowly retreated.
Jia Heng pondered for a moment and said: "Brother Han, this is the first time we meet, how can I make you spend so much money?"
He and Han Hui had only just met each other for the first time, and it was hard to understand why this man entertained him with such a feast.
This may be somewhat of a persecution paranoia.
Han Hui smiled and said, "Brother Jia, you're welcome. Even if we don't meet Brother Jia, Wendu and I are going to come here to have a try. Brother Jia just sit back and sit quietly. Next time, if we can't decide, we can just find a noodle stall on the roadside and we can talk while eating."
Yu Zhen also smiled and said, "Brother Han is right. We eat in the Imperial College every day and it's just for this meal."
Seeing the two of them singing along and talking honestly and interestingly, Jia Heng just laughed and said, "I'm rude."
Then, I accepted it calmly.
Han Hui's eyes flashed and he nodded secretly. This Ning Guogong's Jia Gongzi behaved well, neither humble nor arrogant. He didn't look like he came from a small family. He thought to himself that he was worthy of being a person who could write such sentences as "Many things in ancient and modern times can be laughed at."
There is a saying that no noble can be raised in three generations. If one comes from a humble background and meets a powerful person, he will either flatter himself or be arrogant.
Han Hui has a wide circle of friends and may not have other abilities, but this ability of observing faces has been developed through experience.
He brought this down-and-out young man from Ningguo Mansion here intentionally just to see his character.
No matter from the appearance of the pretty maid just now, to the calm look on Brother Jia's face and his clear eyes, to the calmness and composure after hearing about Chuhua Tower, he doesn't look like a child from a poor family.
The three of them ate tea and talked.
After talking to him, Han Hui nodded secretly when he saw that his answers were fluent and his knowledge was extraordinary.
As soon as we talked, we mentioned the imperial examination.
